diagnostics.message: aws_lambda_function.webhook is created before aws_cloudwatch_log_group.webhook, because the log group's name is derived from aws_lambda_function.webhook.function_name (the dependency currently runs the wrong way). For the Lambda to write to the managed log group with the configured retention/KMS (instead of letting Lambda auto-create an unmanaged log group on first invocation), the managed log group should exist before the function. No attribute reference expresses this ordering in the needed direction; the log group name should be refactored (e.g. derived from a local like "${var.config.prefix}-webhook") so the function can be ordered after the log group.
